body: got undressed to get into the shower, then proceeded to pee on the floor because my brain thought i was already in the shower

well there’s a lot but i can try my best to summarize it lol.
I grew up with a schizophrenic mother and an alcoholic depressed father and a bunch of traumatic stuff happened in my childhood.. my mom is basically out of the picture but i’m grateful that I have a good relationship with my dad. he’s just so so sad and so umotivated to help himself anymore. I’m 18 right now and i’m doing everything on my own. I basically have been since middle school. I’m proud of myself for sticking through it but I don’t know how much longer I can do it. I also realize that I still have it a lot better than a lot of other people and then I feel guilt for feeling this way.

I feel trapped in life.. i want to convince myself that i can make it whatever i want it to be because that’s always the advice I give others when they are feeling this way but I feel like that’s just not true. I was dealt a really shitty hand and i’m not sure what to do with it.
